title: "Data: hyperevents"
---

```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
source("data/catalogue/helpers.R")
downloads <- utils::read.csv("data/catalogue/downloads.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
ids <- c("enron-perry-wolfe", "benson-drive", "benson-scholp", "xgi-data", "govinfo-billstatus-118", "openalex-social-networks-journal")
```

Events with a set of senders and a set of receivers: an email to several recipients, a bill with a sponsor and cosponsors, a question thread with its participants, a paper's authors citing a set of references. They are the input of relational hyperevent models; see the [hyperedge article](hyperedge-models.html) for the data model.

The [data catalogue](data-catalogue.html) lists every dataset with its licence. Figures
and numbers on this page are aggregates computed from the files as published;
each section links the source and the code that reads it.

```{r summary-table}
summary_table(ids)
```

```{r sections, results = "asis"}
render_group(ids)
```
